mara: Quick microtalk runbook for tonight at Signal Hall. Goal: 6x8min demos + 2 volunteers per rotation for QR lead-tagging and swag handoffs. Courier pickup at 15:00. Please read and ack. :boom:
aj: I can cover rotation A (slots 1-2) and handle handoffs. courier confirmed 15:00, driver Jerry.
devin: I'll do rotation C (slots 5-6) and stand lead for fallback laptop. packing list in the thread below.
sophie: I'll bring the extra QR cards and the lead spreadsheet on iPad. Can someone confirm the QR redirect UTM?
luis: Swag pickup plan: boxes at warehouse #12. I scheduled courier: pickup 15:00, delivery to venue 16:20, on-site contact @aj.
mara: QR redirect should be /r/nyc23?utm_source=booth&utm_campaign=microtalks - sophie pls confirm with growth. Keep short form to avoid long URLs.
sophie: confirmed. I'll also add ?list=micros so we can segment.
badgebot: Badge printer status: READY — 24 printed, 6 on hold for last-minute walk-ins.
mara: Run-of-show (condensed):
- 16:45 doors open, demo setup staging 16:00-16:30
- 17:00 session start
- 17:00-17:48 Microtalk block 1 (3 talks, 8m + 2m transitions)
- 17:50-18:30 Microtalk block 2 (3 talks)
- 18:30-19:00 Rapid Q&A + lead capture push
Keep transitions tight.
aj: Volunteer shifts (two people each):
- Shift 1 (16:50-17:30): aj + mara
- Shift 2 (17:25-18:05): devin + sophie
- Shift 3 (18:00-19:00): luis + mara
I'll post a shared Google sheet with assignments in 10.
mara: Swag ops: hand one tote + sticker pack per qualified lead. Do not hand swag before they scan QR. If they ask for swag w/o scanning, politely ask to scan first. Script: "Awesome — could you scan this quick card so we can email resources?"
devin: We should include a one-liner for volunteers when redirecting to webinar signup: "Want deeper dive? Sign up for our 30-min demo webinar next Thu — scan and select ‘webinar’ on the form."
sophie: I added webinar options on the form. Also added checkbox for product interest: embeddings, chat, private deploys.
mara: Badge/kit pickup checklist for on-site lead:
```
- Box labels matched to slot (A/B/C)
- 6 demo dongles & HDMI adapter
- 20 QR cards in clip
- Swag totes 60 total (reserve 10)
- Sharpies, tape, gaffer
- Lead sheet iPad charged
```
aj: Can we get a quick print-ready sheet for volunteers with the two-sentence pitch and the scan flow? I'll print 10 copies.
mara: Yes — short pitch: "We help teams ship LLM features with predictable latency and predictable unit costs. Try a hosted demo or request a private trial." Keep it <25 words.
luis: Courier contact: Jerry +1-555-0199, company: FastRun. Tracking: FR-7812.
sophie: Final ask to speakers: please upload slide deck + 1-sentence bio to the shared drive by 13:00 today. I emailed all 6.
mara: Last-mile: volunteers please arrive 16:30 for rapid briefing. If anyone can't make shift, mark on the sheet now so we can reshuffle. :raised_hands: 
aj: acked. I'll be there 16:10 to meet the courier.
devin: ack. I'll bring the spare power strip.
sophie: ack and pinged speakers who haven't uploaded.
